items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: So you were in your early 20s and you’re going to go on the road with the Woody Herman Orchestra.

ctx.x: Did you have to audition for Woody Herman?

Oh yeah. I usually like to — see when musicians would come to nearby places to be for a week or two, a lake resort, that kind of thing, I was always familiar with the lake resort, having taught, played there a lot. So it gave me a chance to see the musicians even during the day, like if they were rehearsing or at the very least I could certainly find a lot of individuals to talk to that were a help. When it was time for me to audition for Woody I had already gotten to know his book just from listening. The…
That’s terrific. So you were in your early 20s and you’re going to go on the road with the Woody Herman Orchestra. I mean this is an obvious question, but were you excited about it?
